messages:
alex: Quick update from the kernel ablation runs across us-east / eu-west. Ran flashv2, flashv3, triton-vend on H100 and A100 for the new llama-ish model at seq=1024, bs=1/8/32. Raw numbers attached, but TL;DR: flashv3 wins latency on H100 for bs<=8, triton-vend is better for bs>=32 on A100.

maria: nice, can you paste the p95s?

alex: p95s: H100 flashv3 bs=1=12ms, bs=8=18ms, bs=32=45ms. A100 triton-vend bs=32=40ms, flashv3 bs=32=52ms. Throughput top for A100 with triton-vend.

bench-bot: automated note: quality check (quant q8) failed on flashv3 at bs=8, delta-bleu= -0.8 vs fp16 baseline for 200 eval prompts. See eval id: eval-2026-03-20-42.

dan: ugh, regression on q8? Is that deterministic or noisy?

alex: it's consistent across 3 seeds. The failure seems tied to the q8 matmul path in flashv3 under short sequence heavy attention. Not seen on triton-vend.

sophie: can you share the minimal repro logs?

alex: snippet: ```
[run] model=llama-2-mini quant=q8 kernel=flashv3 seq=128 bs=8
WARN: attn_precision_fallback: fallback to float32 for softmax at layer 10
OUT: sample_001: "The cat sat on the..." -> truncated / missing continuation
```

maria: interesting warning. maybe an FP accumulation corner. Have we tried hybrid: flashv3 but force softmax to fp16?

dan: i ran a quick patch: `--force-softmax-fp16` and re-ran 100 prompts, regression reduced to -0.2. latency +1-2ms.

alex: that's promising. But we need policy for switching kernels across regions: eu-west currently defaults to triton-vend for cost reasons, us-east to flashv3. If we roll hybrid in us-east, need rollback triggers.

infra-bot: deploy plan note: canary gateway set to 5% traffic, cooldown 30m, rollback if quality_drop >= 0.5 BLEU within window.

sophie: suggestion: add hysteresis to kernel selector — only switch if p95 improvement > 8% AND quality delta < 0.3. prevents oscillation during noisy windows.

alex: agreed. Also want automatic fallback from flashv3->triton-vend on q8 quality signal. Implementation idea: route policy with ordered fallbacks and weighted ramps: `{primary: flashv3, fallback: triton-vend, weight_ramp: 0->100 over 10min, quality_sla: BLEU_loss<=0.3}`.

maria: pls add a metric for "attn-softmax-fallback-rate" so we can correlate warnings to quality drops.

dan: i'll add the metric in runtime patch and surface it in console. Quick grep of logs showed the warning spikes correspond to 0.7% of tokens in worst hosts.

bench-bot: perf artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/2026-03/1705554321-kernel-ablation/perf-report.html

alex: next steps: (1) infra: canary config + hysteresis rules (dan/sophie), (2) runtime: expose attn-softmax-fallback-rate metric (dan), (3) eval: run 10k prompt regression with hybrid softmax on H100/us-east and triton-vend in eu-west (maria). I'll kick off the larger run tomorrow and post results.

maria: ack, i'll queue evals and include both quant levels q8/q4 for completeness.

sophie: i'll draft a short playbook for reactive rollback, include a `curl` snippet to flip selector if needed.

dan: here's canary json I pushed to staging: ```json
{
  "selector": "kernel_router_v2",
  "primary": "flashv3",
  "fallback": "triton-vend",
  "canary_pct": 5,
  "ramp_minutes": 10,
  "quality_threshold_bleu": 0.3,
  "hysteresis_pct": 8
}
```

alex: perfect. Thanks everyone. Will monitor bench-bot and alerts tomorrow morning. :eyes:

infra-bot: alert rule suggestion: trigger if attn-softmax-fallback-rate > 0.5% AND BLEU_drop > 0.25 over 15m.

maria: noted. If regression persists after hybrid, we may need to pin A100 workloads to triton-vend for certain routes.

alex: yep. Closing here for now — will post the 10k-run link when ready.
